name: default-values
title: The defaults, as documented and as coded
description: The help states defaults in prose - quick is the default verify level, the stored profile is used unless one is given - and the code states them too, in argparse defaults, in PowerShell parameter defaults and in TypeScript fallbacks. A documented default the code does not use means the tool behaves differently from the promise when a user omits the flag, with nothing to say so
creator: aixi
